items.title: Ike Robertson Interview, 1961-04-28
items.q: I said, you know what you playing, Colin? I said, yeah, come on. He got into trouble and went down that way.

ctx.x: I might want you to go down the bridge way with me. I said, you know what you playing, Colin? I said, yeah, come on. He got into trouble and went down that way. I was surprised. I'm telling you, he was playing just like Chris Kelly. Yeah. Mm-hmm. Did the job nice. Well, did Chris ever play a lot of high notes? Sometimes.
He won't to. Not too much. Look like. You can make some high notes, but he plays down.
